description: Third-party agent skills used locally alongside the skills published in this repo. They are NOT vendored here: each belongs to its original author, so this file records where to get it and how to update it.

installer.note: Installs into ~/.agents/skills. Each source below lists the skill names to pass via repeated -s flags.

sources.author: Paul Bakaus
sources.notes: Upstream ships a single 'impeccable' skill that covers the notAvailableUpstream names as sub-commands, in reference/*.md. Those standalone sibling directories are leftovers from an older layout and are no longer installable by name; impeccable supersedes them.

sources.author: Matt Pocock
sources.notes: All upstream skills are installed except 'prototype', whose name is now owned by emilkowalski/skills (see that entry); install mattpocock's copy only if you intend to displace Emil's. Six local names are outdated because upstream renamed or withdrew them: diagnose -> diagnosing-bugs, to-issues -> to-tickets, to-prd -> to-spec, write-a-skill -> writing-for-agents (via writing-great-skills). caveman and zoom-out were removed outright with no successor; the local copies still work but will not update. Update with 'npx skills@latest update -g', then re-link the harnesses. See AGENTS.md.

sources.author: Supabase
sources.notes: skill-creator was installed from this repo in Jan 2026 but is no longer published there; upstream now offers 'supabase' and 'supabase-postgres-best-practices'.

sources.author: Emil Kowalski
sources.notes: All 15 listed upstream skills are installed. 'animate' and 'prototype' share their names with skills from other sources and were deliberately overwritten with Emil's versions: the local animate does not track pbakaus/impeccable (which only ever shipped it as a superseded leftover), and prototype does not track mattpocock/skills. Upstream also ships 'animation-performance': keeps web animations inside the frame budget.

sources.author: Alejandro Bailo
sources.notes: Enforces a strict no-direct-useEffect rule in React/React Native. A local copy existed in a previous skill store but was not tracked as a source here, so a fresh machine would not get it.

sources.author: Ayoub G.
sources.notes: Output-style skill: action-first replies, numbered steps, no preamble or closers. The standard's `style` section inlines the rules as a fallback, so this is optional.

tools.name: codebase-memory-mcp
tools.author: DeusData
tools.usedBy: `code-discovery` — the code graph it queries, and `scripts/cbm-here.sh`
tools.notes: Installed separately by its own installer; it is a binary, not a skill, so it is not in `sources`. The skill only documents how to install and register it.

tools.name: skills
tools.author: Vercel, Inc.
tools.notes: The CLI that resolves and installs every `sources` entry. It is run via npx, never vendored.
